% Pattern: number/section. The paper writes each section with a command of two
% arguments that writes \section with the second and labels it with the first,
% so the theorems numbered within the section are 1.1 and 2.1. Seen in the gold
% pilot (set X).
% want theorem-1 statement/theorem 1.1
% want theorem-2 statement/theorem 2.1 labels=t:b
\documentclass{article}
\renewcommand{\sec}[2]{\section{#2}\label{s:#1}}
\newtheorem{theorem}{Theorem}[section]
\begin{document}
\sec{one}{The first part}
\begin{theorem} Every compact space is bounded. \end{theorem}
\sec{two}{The second part}
\begin{theorem}\label{t:b} Every finite space is compact. \end{theorem}
\end{document}
